name: Confluence Data Center
covers: Pages, spaces, search, comments, labels, attachments
credentialNote: The default connection uses TOIL_JIRA_API_TOKEN when no Confluence token is set, only if the default Jira connection is Data Center; another connection can borrow a Jira connection's token with apiTokenFrom

supported.note: toil authenticates with a personal access token, which Confluence Data Center added in 7.9. No release has been verified yet.
